task_fulfillment.rationale: The document substantially covers sincere engagement, scenarios, BATNA, tooling diplomacy and executive negotiation. Material corrections are needed before operational use: the continuity schedule commits to unconfirmed ramp/component availability, assumes transfer is included in plastics redevelopment, and counts production without a receipt-level transit bridge. Advance-payment offers also need reconciliation with the payment red line. Only one artifact was supplied; there are no companion files to assess. The 2–3-page limit cannot be verified from text extraction, and is not the basis for failure.
